entries.title: Tukohama tribe island
entries.text: A small island in the centre of the area, connected by a red totem bridge, holds a pack of Tukohama tribe monsters from the Trial of the Ancestors. Drops 1–2 random tattoos when first killed.

entries.title: Hidden tunnel
entries.text: Interact with a switch on the wall in a corner of the area, near the end of the Labyrinth Trial, to unlock a small hidden tunnel containing a random transfigured gem.
